plr.Character local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root or not S.enabled then state.valid = false markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false return end local now = os.clock() local rootCF = root.CFrame local chest = rootCF.Position + rootCF.UpVector * 0.5 + rootCF.LookVector * 1.2 local moveL = V3(leftDelta.X * 1.8, -leftDelta.Y * 1.8, 0) local moveR = if remote and now - lastSend >= CFG.sendRate then lastSend = now remote:FireServer(headSmooth, rootCF * hands.L.cf, rootCF * hands.R.cf) end if S.hud then local pl, onL = --========================================================--
-- GOJO NPC KILLER
-- R6 + R15 | MOBILE + PC
--
-- Blue            = 3s cooldown
-- Red             = 5s cooldown + red explosion
-- Hollow Purple   = 10s cooldown + BIG
-- Limitless Fly   = 5s cooldown / INFINITE FLIGHT
-- Teleport        = 3s cooldown
--
-- LIMITLESS FLY:
-- • Infinite duration
-- • Control with WASD / mobile joystick
-- • Camera controls direction
-- • Unequip tool to stop flying
-- NPC ONLY
--========================================================--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

--========================================================--
-- CHARACTER
--========================================================--

local Character
local Humanoid
local Root

local function SetupCharacter(char)

	Character = char
	Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	Root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

end

SetupCharacter(
	Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
)

--========================================================--
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================--

local BLUE_DAMAGE = 35
local RED_DAMAGE = 50
local PURPLE_DAMAGE = 500

local NPC_PUSH = 35
local NPC_FREEZE_TIME = 2.5

local BLUE_COOLDOWN = 3
local RED_COOLDOWN = 5
local PURPLE_COOLDOWN = 10
local FLY_COOLDOWN = 5
local TELEPORT_COOLDOWN = 3

local FLY_SPEED = 75

local TELEPORT_DISTANCE = 35

local BLUE_SPEED = 50
local RED_SPEED = 135
local PURPLE_SPEED = 180

local BLUE_SIZE = 1.5
local RED_SIZE = 1.8
local PURPLE_SIZE = 5

--========================================================--
-- SOUNDS
--========================================================--

local SOUND = {
	BlueCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	BlueFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	RedCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	RedFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	PurpleCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	PurpleFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	Impact = "rbxassetid://12222152",

	Teleport = "rbxassetid://5568266006",

	FlyStart = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	FlyEnd = "rbxassetid://12222152",
}

--========================================================--
-- COOLDOWNS
--========================================================--

local Cooldown = {
	Blue = false,
	Red = false,
	Purple = false,
	Fly = false,
	Teleport = false
}

local function TryCooldown(name, time)

	if Cooldown[name] then
		return false
	end

	Cooldown[name] = true

	task.delay(time, function()
		Cooldown[name] = false
	end)

	return true
end

--========================================================--
-- SOUND
--========================================================--

local function PlaySound(id, volume, speed)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = volume or 1
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed or 1

	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = 5

	sound.Parent = Root

	sound:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(sound, 10)

end

--========================================================--
-- NPC CHECK
--========================================================--

local function GetNPC(part)

	if not part then
		return nil
	end

	local model =
		part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

	if not model then
		return nil
	end

	if model == Character then
		return nil
	end

	-- NEVER target players
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
		return nil
	end

	local humanoid =
		model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	return model
end

--========================================================--
-- RED EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function RedExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "RedExplosion"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		20,
		20
	)

	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Transparency = 0.1

	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false

	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		0,
		0
	)

	light.Brightness = 15
	light.Range = 30
	light.Parent = part

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.4,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			Size = Vector3.new(14, 14, 14),
			Transparency = 1
		}
	)

	tween:Play()

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.Impact,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	Debris:AddItem(
		part,
		0.5
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- PURPLE EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function PurpleExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "HollowPurpleExplosion"

	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(

local Flying = false
local FlyConnection
local FlyVelocity
local FlyTool

local function StopFly()

	if not Flying then
		return
	end

	Flying = false

	if FlyConnection then
		FlyConnection:Disconnect()
		FlyConnection = nil
	end

	if FlyVelocity then
		FlyVelocity:Destroy()
		FlyVelocity = nil
	end

	if Humanoid then
		Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyEnd,
		1.2,

	)

local function StartFly()

	if Flying then
		return
	end

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Fly",
		FLY_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	if not Root or not Humanoid then
		return
	end

	Flying = true

	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyStart,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	FlyVelocity =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	FlyVelocity.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			math.huge,
			math.huge,
			math.huge
		)

	FlyVelocity.Velocity =
		Vector3.zero

	FlyVelocity.Parent =
		Root

	FlyConnection =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
			function()

				if not Flying then
					return
				end

				if not Root
					or not Root.Parent
					or not Humanoid
					or Humanoid.Health <= 0
				then

					StopFly()
					return

				end

				local camera =
					workspace.CurrentCamera

				if not camera then
					return
				end

				-- Get normal player movement
				local moveDirection =
					Humanoid.MoveDirection

				-- Camera direction
				local cameraLook =
					camera.CFrame.LookVector

				local cameraRight =
					camera.CFrame.RightVector

				-- Convert normal movement into
				-- camera-relative 3D flight movement.
				local forwardAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraLook.X,
							0,
							cameraLook.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local rightAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraRight.X,
							0,
							cameraRight.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local direction =
					Vector3.zero

				-- Forward/backward follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraLook *
					forwardAmount

				-- Left/right follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraRight *
					rightAmount

				-- Preserve vertical camera direction
				-- when moving forward/backward.
				if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then

					direction =
						direction.Unit

					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						direction *
						FLY_SPEED

					-- Face the direction of flight
					Root.CFrame =
						CFrame.lookAt(
							Root.Position,
							Root.Position +
							direction
						)

				else

					-- No movement = hover in place
					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						Vector3.zero

				end

			end
		)

end

		Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		Character
	}

	local result =
		workspace:Raycast(
			Root.Position,
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE,
			params
		)

	local destination

	if result then

		destination =
			result.Position -
			direction * 3

	else

		destination =
			Root.Position +
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE

	end

	Root.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(

		)

local function RemoveGojoTools()

	local backpack =

	local function Clean(container)

		if not container then
			return
		end

		for _, object in
			ipairs(container:GetChildren())
		do

			if object:IsA("Tool") then

				for _, data in
					ipairs(ToolData)
				do

					if object.Name ==
						data.Name
					then

						object:Destroy()
						break

					end

				end

			end

		end

	end

	Clean(backpack)
	Clean(Character)

end

local function CreateTool(data)

	local backpack =
		Player:WaitForChild(
			"Backpack",
			10
		)

	if not backpack then
		warn("GOJO: Backpack was not found!")
		return
	end

	-- Don't create duplicate
	if backpack:FindFirstChild(data.Name) then
		return
	end

	if Character and
		Character:FindFirstChild(data.Name)
	then
		return
	end

	local tool =
		Instance.new("Tool")

	tool.Name =
		data.Name

	tool.ToolTip =
		data.Tooltip

	tool.RequiresHandle =
		false

	tool.CanBeDropped =
		false

	tool.Enabled =
		true

	tool.Parent =
		backpack

	-- Special handling for Limitless Fly
	if data.Name == "Limitless Fly" then

		FlyTool = tool

		tool.Unequipped:Connect(
			function()

				StopFly()

			end
		)

	end

	tool.Activated:Connect(
		function()

			if not tool.Enabled then
				return
			end

			task.spawn(
				data.Action
			)

		end
	)

end

	if CreatingTools then

	end

	CreatingTools = true

	local backpack =

		)

	if not backpack then

		warn(
			"GOJO: Could not find Backpack!"
		)

	end

	-- Small delay prevents respawn race conditions
	task.wait(0.2)

	RemoveGojoTools()

	task.wait(0.1)

	for _, data in
		ipairs(ToolData)
	do

		CreateTool(data)

	end

	CreatingTools = false

	print(
		"GOJO: All 5 tools created!"
	)

end

local function createSlider(parent, text, min, max, defaultVal, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 64)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    frame.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = frame
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.Parent = frame
    
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame
    
    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 28)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 6)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
    valLbl.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    valLbl.TextSize = 13
    valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valLbl.Parent = frame
    
    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 8)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 40)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
    sliderBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBg.Parent = frame
    
    local sbgc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sbgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    sbgc.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((defaultVal - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fc.Parent = fill
    
    local draggingSlider = false
    local function updateValue(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(val)
        callback(val)
    end
    
    sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    return frame
end

-- Kidnap Command & Control GUI Script (Fixed Throttling & Teleport Sequence)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local DEFAULT_MODEL_ID = 3544143040

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- F3X Endpoint Resolver
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function GetF3X()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    local tool = (char and (char:FindFirstChild("Building Tools") or char:FindFirstChild("F3X"))) 
        or (backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Building Tools") or backpack:FindFirstChild("F3X")))
    
    if tool then
        local syncAPI = tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") or tool:FindFirstChild("SyncApi")
        if syncAPI then
            local endpoint = syncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint") or syncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerControl")
            if endpoint then return endpoint end
        end
        for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("RemoteFunction") or desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return desc
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function MapPartType(part)
    if part:IsA("WedgePart") then return "Wedge" end
    if part:IsA("CornerWedgePart") then return "Corner" end
    if part:IsA("TrussPart") then return "Truss" end
    if part:IsA("Part") then
        if part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then return "Sphere" end
        if part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then return "Cylinder" end
    end
    return "Normal"
end

local function SafeGetObjects(id)
    local loaded = false
    local result = nil
    
    task.spawn(function()
        local success, raw = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)) end)
        if success and raw and #raw > 0 then
            result = raw[1]
        end
        loaded = true
    end)
    
    local timeWaited = 0
    while not loaded and timeWaited < 8 do
        task.wait(0.05)
        timeWaited += 0.05
    end
    
    return result
end

local function GetContainerBoundingBox(object)
    if object:IsA("Model") then
        local success, cf, size = pcall(function() return object:GetBoundingBox() end)
        if success and cf and size then
            return cf, size
        end
    elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
        return object.CFrame, object.Size
    end
    
    local parts = {}
    for _, desc in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, desc)
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        return CFrame.new(), Vector3.new(4, 1, 2)
    end
    
    local minX, minY, minZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
    local maxX, maxY, maxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
    
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        local cf = part.CFrame
        local size = part.Size
        local pmin = cf.Position - size/2
        local pmax = cf.Position + size/2
        minX = math.min(minX, pmin.X); minY = math.min(minY, pmin.Y); minZ = math.min(minZ, pmin.Z)
        maxX = math.max(maxX, pmax.X); maxY = math.max(maxY, pmax.Y); maxZ = math.max(maxZ, pmax.Z)
    end
    
    local center = Vector3.new((minX + maxX)/2, (minY + maxY)/2, (minZ + maxZ)/2)
    local size = Vector3.new(maxX - minX, maxY - minY, maxZ - minZ)
    return CFrame.new(center), size
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fast Parallel Asset Import
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function FastImportModel(endpoint, modelId, spawnCFrame)
    local rootObject = SafeGetObjects(modelId)
    if not rootObject then return nil, {}, {}, {} end

    local boundingCFrame = GetContainerBoundingBox(rootObject)
    local partsToImport = {}

    if rootObject:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(partsToImport, rootObject) end
    for _, child in ipairs(rootObject:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(partsToImport, child) end
    end

    if #partsToImport == 0 then
        rootObject:Destroy()
        return nil, {}, {}, {}
    end

    local createdF3XParts = {}
    local primaryPart = nil
    local doorParts = {}
    local createdMap = {}

    local pending = #partsToImport
    local bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

    for idx, part in ipairs(partsToImport) do
        task.spawn(function()
            local targetCFrame = spawnCFrame * boundingCFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
            local partType = MapPartType(part)
            
            local ok, createdPart = pcall(function()
                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    return endpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", partType, targetCFrame, workspace)
                else
                    endpoint:FireServer("CreatePart", partType, targetCFrame, workspace)
                end
            end)
            
            if ok and createdPart then
                createdMap[idx] = { Instance = createdPart, Original = part, TargetCFrame = targetCFrame }
            end

            pending -= 1
            if pending <= 0 then
                bindable:Fire()
            end
        end)
    end

    if pending > 0 then
        bindable.Event:Wait()
    end
    bindable:Destroy()

    local resizeBatch, colorBatch, matBatch, anchorBatch, collisionBatch = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    local createMeshesBatch, syncMeshBatch = {}, {}

    for idx = 1, #partsToImport do
        if createdMap[idx] then
            local c = createdMap[idx].Instance
            local p = createdMap[idx].Original
            local t = createdMap[idx].TargetCFrame

            table.insert(createdF3XParts, c)
            if not primaryPart or p.Name == "Primary" or p.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or p.Name == "Body" then
                primaryPart = c
            end

            if string.find(string.lower(p.Name), "door") then
                table.insert(doorParts, c)
            end

            table.insert(resizeBatch, { Part = c, CFrame = t, Size = p.Size })
            table.insert(colorBatch, { Part = c, Color = p.Color })
            table.insert(matBatch, { Part = c, Material = p.Material, Transparency = p.Transparency })
            table.insert(anchorBatch, { Part = c, Anchored = true })
            table.insert(collisionBatch, { Part = c, CanCollide = false })

            if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
                table.insert(createMeshesBatch, { Part = c })
                table.insert(syncMeshBatch, {
                    Part = c,
                    MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh,
                    MeshId = p.MeshId,
                    TextureId = p.TextureID or "",
                    Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                })
            end

            for _, descendant in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                if descendant:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    table.insert(createMeshesBatch, { Part = c })
                    table.insert(syncMeshBatch, {
                        Part = c,
                        MeshType = descendant.MeshType,
                        MeshId = descendant.MeshId,
                        TextureId = descendant.TextureId,
                        Scale = descendant.Scale,
                        Offset = descendant.Offset,
                        VertexColor = descendant.VertexColor
                    })
                elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") or descendant:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                    pcall(function()
                        local clone = descendant:Clone()
                        clone.Parent = c
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function SendBatch(method, batch)
        if #batch == 0 then return end
        local chunkSize = 200
        for i = 1, #batch, chunkSize do
            local chunk = {}
            for j = i, math.min(i + chunkSize - 1, #batch) do
                table.insert(chunk, batch[j])
            end
            pcall(function()
                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    endpoint:InvokeServer(method, chunk)
                else
                    endpoint:FireServer(method, chunk)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    SendBatch("SyncResize", resizeBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncColor", colorBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncAnchor", anchorBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncCollision", collisionBatch)
    if #createMeshesBatch > 0 then SendBatch("CreateMeshes", createMeshesBatch) end
    if #syncMeshBatch > 0 then SendBatch("SyncMesh", syncMeshBatch) end

    primaryPart = primaryPart or createdF3XParts[1]

    local partOffsets = {}
    if primaryPart then
        local primaryStartCF = primaryPart.CFrame
        for _, part in ipairs(createdF3XParts) do
            partOffsets[part] = primaryStartCF:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
        end
    end

    rootObject:Destroy()
    return primaryPart, createdF3XParts, partOffsets, doorParts
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Target Resolver (Prefix / First-Letter Match)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getTargets(arg)
    if not arg or arg == "" then return {LocalPlayer} end
    arg = string.lower(arg)

    if arg == "me" then
        return {LocalPlayer}
    elseif arg == "all" then
        return Players:GetPlayers()
    elseif arg == "others" then
        local matched = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(matched, p) end
        end
        return matched
    end

    local matched = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = string.lower(p.Name)
        local disp = string.lower(p.DisplayName)
        
        if string.sub(name, 1, #arg) == arg or string.sub(disp, 1, #arg) == arg or string.find(name, arg, 1, true) or string.find(disp, arg, 1, true) then
            table.insert(matched, p)
        end
    end
    return matched
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Core Kidnap Execution
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function executeKidnap(targetPlayer, modelId, driveDistance, moveSpeed)
    task.spawn(function()
        local endpoint = GetF3X()
        if not endpoint then
            warn("Kidnap Error: F3X Building Tools not found!")
            return
        end

        local char = targetPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end

        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isLocal = (targetPlayer == LocalPlayer)

        if torso and humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
            humanoid.JumpPower = 0
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false

            local tPos = torso.CFrame
            local approachDist = math.clamp(driveDistance * 0.4, 200, 1000)
            local spawnPos = tPos * (CFrame.new(-approachDist, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            local primary, allParts, offsets, doorParts = FastImportModel(endpoint, modelId, spawnPos)
            if not primary or #allParts == 0 then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                humanoid.JumpPower = 50
                humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                return
            end

            local function check()
                return targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players and torso and humanoid and torso.Parent and humanoid.Parent and char and char.Parent
            end

            local sound, chuckle
            if isLocal then
                sound = Instance.new("Sound", primary)
                sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://532147820"
                sound.Looped = true
                sound:Play()

                chuckle = Instance.new("Sound", primary)
                chuckle.SoundId = "rbxassetid://109527445730513"
                chuckle.Looped = true
                chuckle.Volume = 0.25
                chuckle:Play()
            end

            local function SetDoorTransparency(transparencyValue)
                if #doorParts > 0 then
                    local matBatch = {}
                    for _, dPart in ipairs(doorParts) do
                        table.insert(matBatch, { Part = dPart, Material = dPart.Material, Transparency = transparencyValue })
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
                        else
                            endpoint:FireServer("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            -- Throttled Drive Loop (20Hz Server Network Update Rate)
            local function SmoothThrottledDrive(startCF, targetCF, speed)
                local dist = (targetCF.Position - startCF.Position).Magnitude
                local duration = math.max(0.2, dist / speed)
                local startTime = os.clock()
                local lastNetworkSend = 0
                local sendInterval = 0.05 -- 20 FPS network sync rate to prevent server throttling
                local thread = coroutine.running()
                local conn

                conn = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                    if not check() then
                        conn:Disconnect()
                        task.spawn(thread)
                        return
                    end

                    local now = os.clock()
                    local elapsed = now - startTime
                    local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
                    local currentCF = startCF:Lerp(targetCF, alpha)

                    -- Update server positions at 20Hz interval
                    if (now - lastNetworkSend) >= sendInterval or alpha >= 1 then
                        lastNetworkSend = now
                        local batchMove = {}
                        for part, offsetCF in pairs(offsets) do
                            table.insert(batchMove, { Part = part, CFrame = currentCF * offsetCF })
                        end

                        task.spawn(function()
                            pcall(function()
                                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                    endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMove", batchMove)
                                else
                                    endpoint:FireServer("SyncMove", batchMove)
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end

                    if alpha >= 1 then
                        conn:Disconnect()
                        task.spawn(thread)
                    end
                end)

                coroutine.yield()
            end

            -- Drive Approach Phase
            local approachStartCF = spawnPos
            local approachTargetCF = tPos * (CFrame.new(0, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            SmoothThrottledDrive(approachStartCF, approachTargetCF, moveSpeed)

            if sound then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.9 end
            task.wait(0.1)
            if check() then SetDoorTransparency(1) end
            task.wait(0.2)

            -- Lock Player Inside Vehicle
            local activeWeld = nil
            local lockConnection = nil

            if check() then
                local vehicleInsideCF = primary.CFrame * (CFrame.new(0, 2.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
                
                if isLocal then
                    torso.Anchored = true
                    torso.CFrame = vehicleInsideCF

                    lockConnection = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                        if check() and primary and primary.Parent then
                            torso.CFrame = primary.CFrame * (CFrame.new(0, 2.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                            if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncAnchor", {{ Part = torso, Anchored = false }})
                                endpoint:InvokeServer("CreateWelds", { primary }, torso)
                            else
                                endpoint:FireServer("SyncAnchor", {{ Part = torso, Anchored = false }})
                                endpoint:FireServer("CreateWelds", { primary }, torso)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    torso.CFrame = vehicleInsideCF
                    activeWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    activeWeld.Part0 = primary
                    activeWeld.Part1 = torso
                    activeWeld.Parent = primary
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.2)
            if check() then SetDoorTransparency(0) end
            task.wait(0.2)

            if sound then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.3 end

            -- Drive Away Phase
            local driveAwayStartCF = approachTargetCF
            local driveAwayTargetCF = tPos * (CFrame.new(driveDistance, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            SmoothThrottledDrive(driveAwayStartCF, driveAwayTargetCF, moveSpeed)

            if isLocal and targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
                pcall(function()
                    TeleportService:Teleport(131190128172062, targetPlayer)
                end)
            end

            task.wait(0.2)

            if lockConnection then lockConnection:Disconnect() end
            if isLocal and torso then torso.Anchored = false end
            if activeWeld then pcall(function() activeWeld:Destroy() end) end

            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                        endpoint:InvokeServer("Remove", allParts)
                    else
                        endpoint:FireServer("Remove", allParts)
                    end
                end)
            end)

            pcall(function()
                if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                        humanoid.JumpPower = 50
                        humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end
